metadata.division: DIVISION 4-1-4. NATURAL HAZARDS AND ENVIRONMENTALLY-SENSITIVE AREAS

content.title: 4-1-4-2. Limits of Development.
content.summary: A.	The Limits of Development ("LOD") shall indicate the specific areas of a subdivision within which the development activity shall be contained in order to avoid areas identified in Section 4-1-4-3, Natural Hazard Areas, and features identified in Section 4-1-4-4, Significant Natural Features.
